decisive_items: a well-defined T1-hypointense, STIR-hyperintense lesion with a thick sclerotic rim in the anterolateral cortex of the left femoral head
mild to moderate chronic synovitis with lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates
response.rationale: The lesion with a thick sclerotic rim, chronic lymphoplasmacytic synovitis, negative cultures, and unremarkable rheumatologic evaluation are highly specific for CRMO. Chronic osteomyelitis is contradicted by normal labs and negative cultures; other candidates lack the distinctive sclerotic-rim lesion or are contradicted by negative serology/cultures.

rejected.why: Normal inflammatory markers and negative cultures contradict an active infection.
Histology shows chronic synovitis, not neoplastic sarcoma features.
Rheumatologic evaluation and serologies were unremarkable.
Negative cultures and no improvement after anti-tubercular therapy.
No evidence of osteochondromatosis; histology is nonspecific.
No histiocytosis or systemic features; imaging is not specific to LCH.
